svg.title: C16-M05-F1: The Android security model
svg.desc: Per-app sandboxes with private data, permission-gated shared resources, and exportable components.
svg.text: [ app A sandbox ] [ app B sandbox ] (per-app UID; kernel-enforced)
private data private data <- private FROM OTHER APPS by default
shared resources (network, camera, location) -> gated by PERMISSIONS
components may be EXPORTED -> callable by other apps (risk if sensitive)
Figure C16-M05-F1. App sandboxing, permissions and component exposure [C16-M05-R1].
